limitations: Published splits are disjoint indices within one collection; independent-drive generalization is unverified.
Small diagnostic selection: 16 train and 16 test scans; no Cyclist ground truth.
Publisher annotations are model-assisted and human-reviewed according to the original paper; the Extended card does not separately document its annotation procedure.
The 128-beam labeled sensor differs from the 64-beam MOSEP weather sensor; no labeled weather-accuracy claim is made.
Primary model-ROI evaluation excludes 11 of 77 original test labels: two Car outside XY, eight Car and one Pedestrian outside z.
Dur360 requires identical ROI/nonzero-return adaptation because its original 262144 points exceed the engine capacity of 204800.
Fixed signal/65535 versus reflectivity/255 encodings; no claim that every possible signal calibration is inferior.
The frame bootstrap assumes independence; temporal correlation limits interpretation of its intervals.
No production adapter, driver, image or default was changed by these experiments.
ROS UDP transport trials did not complete the A/B. Accuracy observations use unchanged production C++ inference and NMS directly, not ROS delivery.
Capacity control is a separate mechanical sensitivity test, not an automatic production fix.
Bundled Dur360 metadata lacks calibration_status; individual factory reflectivity calibration validity is unverified.
